meta.title: Plugin Hot Apply
meta.description: Watch installed plugins for file changes and apply the newest code to the running composition; restart DSH with one click, or reload only the plugin modules.

title: Plugin Hot Apply
intro: Reload plugin modules automatically after an update while the current session keeps running.
blockedTitle: Modules that cannot be replaced in this process
reasonPackageMoved: The package now resolves to a new directory, so a restart is required.
reasonHostModule: The change touches a module DSH itself already loaded.
reasonUnmanagedPlugin: The change touches a plugin the plugin list does not manage.
reasonModuleComparison: Loaded modules cannot be compared with the files on disk.
updateHint: Updating in place triggers the restart prompt. This removes and reinstalls so the new version can mount in the current process.
